text:
Bitcoin is consolidating in a tight band near $64,500 following a relief rally, establishing strong near-term support at $64,000. Despite stabilizing price action, broader sentiment indicators remain anchored in "Extreme Fear" as institutional capital navigates cross-currents between favorable domestic inflation data and escalating geopolitical friction in the Middle East.

Regulatory tailwinds are accelerating globally, with a Japanese parliamentary committee approving legislation to reclassify digital assets as financial instruments—a pivotal step expected to catalyze localized spot crypto ETFs. Concurrently, Swiss-regulated AMINA Bank's integration of the Mesh network signals continued maturation of institutional settlement infrastructure.

Crypto asset performance remains highly sensitive to traditional macro drivers. As the latest U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) printed a 0.3% contraction, bond yields have softened, providing a structural tailwind for risk-on allocations. However, sustained momentum in digital assets will likely require a definitive dovish pivot from the Federal Reserve to unlock sidelined institutional liquidity.
